reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: syncRoles is a live Express route registered at src/index.ts:68 with non-test callers. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json — lookup not applicable. Gate 3: src/api/ is in scope with no exclusions matching this finding. Code confirms the spec deviation: addRoleToMember/removeRoleFromMember (utils/discord.ts L90-117) swallow errors and return false, but rolesSync.ts L51/L64 never checks these return values, so any Discord API failure silently leaves the postcondition (count==1) violated while returning HTTP 200 success:true. The generationRole==null path (L47) additionally skips removal of pre-existing incorrect generation roles. Attack path is uncertain because triggering Discord API errors requires external conditions (rate-limit, permission revocation) not fully under attacker control, making this CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. Medium severity is appropriate: role enforcement can be silently bypassed, potentially granting or retaining unauthorized generation-role access, but reliable exploitation requires Discord API instability.
